players.product: AI data-center campus leases on converted Bitcoin-mining power sites (Sandersville GA 175 MW critical IT on a 20-year triple net lease, tenant undisclosed; Sealy and Brazoria TX under exclusivity)

quarterly_data.signal: CleanSpark's 10-Q: bitcoin mining revenue for the nine months ended June 30, 2026 was $455,594 (in thousands), down 16% from $542,662, which the company attributes to a lower average bitcoin price and fewer bitcoin mined.

CleanSpark's 10-Q risk disclosure: it is evaluating the scope and enforceability of Texas Governor Greg Abbott's August 3, 2026 letter directing ERCOT and the PUCT to verify and audit all data centers advancing through the interconnection process before they move forward, and the earlier July temporary data center and battery energy storage system moratorium imposed by Austin County; such actions in Texas and Georgia, where its properties are located, could increase capital expenditures, delay development timelines or limit projects from moving forward.
